info.name: Application Performance Monitoring Explorer Trace API
Span details for a given span id.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: spanKey
params.description: Unique Application Performance Monitoring span identifier (spanId).

params.name: traceKey
params.description: Unique Application Performance Monitoring trace identifier (traceId).

params.name: timeSpanStartedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: Include spans that have a `spanStartTime` equal to or greater than this value.

params.name: timeSpanStartedLessThan
params.description: Include spans that have a `spanStartTime`less than this value.

params.name: spanNamespace
params.description: Name space from which the span details need to be retrieved.

items.docs: Gets the span details identified by spanId.

info.name: Trace details for a given traceId.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: traceKey
params.description: Unique Application Performance Monitoring trace identifier (traceId).

params.name: timeTraceStartedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: Include traces that have a minTraceStartTime equal to or greater than this value.

params.name: timeTraceStartedLessThan
params.description: Include traces that have a minTraceStartTime less than this value.

params.name: traceNamespace
params.description: Name space from which the trace details need to be retrieved.

items.docs: Gets the trace details identified by traceId.

info.name: Aggregated snapshot for a given trace ID.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: traceKey
params.description: Unique Application Performance Monitoring trace identifier (traceId).

items.docs: Gets the aggregated snapshot identified by trace ID.

info.name: Trace snapshots data for a given trace ID.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: traceKey
params.description: Unique Application Performance Monitoring trace identifier (traceId).

params.name: isSummarized
params.description: If enabled, only span level details are sent.

params.name: threadId
params.description: Thread ID for which snapshots need to be retrieved. This identifier of a thread is a long positive number generated when a thread is created.

items.docs: Gets the trace snapshots data identified by trace ID.
